dedupe_keys.name: table listant les cartes de risque d inondation produites sur un tri donne

description: Table listant les cartes de risque d’inondation produites sur un TRI donné is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. A series of geographical data produced by the GIS Flooding Directive of the territory of significant risk of flooding (TRI) of Mayotte and mapped for reporting purposes for the European Flood Directive. European Directive 2007/60/EC of 23 October 2007 on the assessment and management of flood risks (OJ L 288, 06-11-2007, p. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Table listing flood risk maps produced on a given IRR" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2020-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
